files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+name: Coverage
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches:
+      - main
+  pull_request:
+
+jobs:
+  verify:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Setup Bun
+        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
+        with:
+          bun-version: 1.3.11
+
+      - name: Install dependencies
+        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
+
+      - name: Run verify
+        run: bun run verify
+
+  coverage:
+    needs: verify
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Setup Bun
+        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
+        with:
+          bun-version: 1.3.11
+
+      - name: Install dependencies
+        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
+
+      - name: Build project before coverage
+        run: bun run build
+
+      - name: Run unit coverage
+        run: bun test tests/unit --coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov --coverage-dir=coverage --run --timeout 20000
+
+      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
+        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
+        with:
+          files: coverage/lcov.info
+          fail_ci_if_error: true
